item.title: Trump threatens tariffs on countries that sell oil to Cuba
item.description: President Trump on Thursday signed an executive order​ that would impose a tariff on any goods from countries that sell or provide oil to Cuba.

item.title: Trump sues IRS and Treasury, accusing agencies of letting his tax returns leak
item.description: President Trump is suing the Internal Revenue Service and Treasury Department for at least $10 billion, claiming the agencies unlawfully allowed an IRS contractor to leak his tax returns and those of his sons and company.

item.title: 1/25: CBS Weekend News
item.description: Winter storm impacts nearly 200 million Americans; Latest details after Border Patrol kills Alex Pretti in Minneapolis.

item.title: Trump threatens Canada with 50% tariff on aircraft sold in U.S.
item.description: President Trump is threatening Canada with a 50% tariff on any aircraft sold in the U.S., the latest salvo in his trade war with America's northern neighbor as his feud with Prime Minister Mark Carney expands.

item.title: 1/25/2026: Timothée Chalamet; Jamie Lee Curtis; Kate Winslet
item.description: 60 Minutes presents a night at the movies, featuring interviews with Timothée Chalamet, Jamie Lee Curtis and Kate Winslet.

item.title: For North Mississippi, a return to normal still weeks away after historic ice storm
item.description: The small Mississippi community of Gravestown has been without power and running water for five days following an ice storm the likes of which the state hasn't seen in more than 30 years.

item.title: Trump says he's announcing new Fed chair nominee Friday morning
item.description: President Trump says he will announce his nominee for Federal Reserve chair Friday morning, as he presses the central bank to cut interest rates.

item.title: Senate reaches deal ahead of shutdown deadline to fund government, continue ICE talks
item.description: The deal comes ahead of the Saturday shutdown deadline, but it will also need the approval of the House, which isn't scheduled to return until Monday — and at least one Republican senator has pushed back.

item.description: Border czar shifts tone in Minneapolis, announces "drawdown"; Buddhist monks' 2,300-mile walk for peace captures widespread attention

item.title: Border czar Homan speaks in Minnesota: "I'm staying till the problem's gone"
item.description: Border czar Tom Homan gave his first news conference Thursday morning since arriving in Minnesota at the request of President Trump.
